message.content:
Based on the provided screenshot of **buskool.com** (درخواست‌های خرید - B2B Purchase Requests), here is a detailed description of the UI components:

### 1. Top Filter Bar
Located immediately below the main page header, this bar provides search and sorting capabilities:
*   **Search Input:** A wide text field on the right (or center) with a placeholder reading "برای جستجو درخواست مورد نظر خود را وارد کنید" (Enter the desired request to search). It features an orange search icon button on its left edge.
*   **Filter Controls (Left/Right aligned):**
    *   **Categories Dropdown:** Labeled "دسته‌بندی" (Category), allowing users to filter by product type.
    *   **Sort/Status:** A button labeled "جدیدترین‌ها" (Newest) with a dropdown arrow, likely for sorting by date or status.
    *   **Location Filter:** A button with a location pin icon and text "همه شهرها" (All Cities).
*   **Style:** Clean white background with light gray borders, using a mix of text and icon buttons.

### 2. Buy Request Card Layout
Each purchase request is displayed as a distinct horizontal card with a white background, subtle border/shadow, and rounded corners. The layout is structured as follows:
*   **Header Row:**
    *   **Right Side:** A generic user avatar (gray silhouette) followed by the **Buyer's Name** (e.g., "مسعود صمدی").
    *   **Left Side:** A bookmark/save icon (outline style).
*   **Main Content (Center):**
    *   **Product Title:** Bold, black text describing the item (e.g., "خرید ۵۰۰ عدد شیرآلات ساختمانی ارزان قیمت با برندهای معتبر").
    *   **Metadata Line:** Located below the title, showing:
        *   **Location:** City name preceded by a map pin icon (e.g., "تهران").
        *   **Date:** Date of posting (e.g., "۱۱ آبان ۱۴۰۲") preceded by a calendar icon.
*   **Action Area (Bottom Left):** Contains two prominent buttons (described below).

### 3. Action Buttons Design
Each card features two side-by-side call-to-action buttons with an orange color scheme:
*   **Primary Button (Solid Orange):** Labeled **"تماس با خریدار"** (Contact Buyer). It has a solid orange background (`#FF9800` approx.), white text, and a phone handset icon on the left.
*   **Secondary Button (Outlined Orange):** Labeled **"چت با خریدار"** (Chat with Buyer). It has a transparent background with an orange border, orange text, and a chat bubble/comment icon on the left.
*   **Styling:** Both buttons have rounded corners (pill-shaped or slightly rounded rectangle), equal height, and are grouped together.

### 4. Middle CTA Card (Promotional Banner)
Inserted within the list of requests (after several cards) is a full-width promotional banner:
*   **Background:** Deep teal/green gradient (`#00695C` to `#004D40`).
*   **Content:**
    *   **Headline:** White bold text: "فروش محصول خود را در بوسکول ثبت کنید!" (Register your product sale on Buskool!).
    *   **Subtext:** Smaller white text explaining the benefit: "با ثبت محصول و عضویت در بوسکول فروشندگی خود را شروع کنید..." (Start your sales by registering...).
    *   **Button:** A white rectangular button with teal text: "ثبت محصول و یافتن خریدار" (Register Product & Find Buyer).
*   **Purpose:** This breaks up the list to encourage sellers (the users viewing these buy requests) to also list their own products.

### 5. Overall Layout and Colors
*   **Layout:** Single-column, vertical list format (feed-style). The content is centered with generous whitespace on desktop views. The header is sticky or fixed at the top.
*   **Color Palette:**
    *   **Primary Brand Color:** **Orange** (`#FF9800` / `#F57C00`) used for search buttons, primary action buttons, and quantity highlights.
    *   **Secondary/Accent:** **Teal/Green** (`#00796B`) used for the CTA banner and some text links.
    *   **Text:** Dark gray/Black (`#333`) for titles, lighter gray (`#777`) for metadata.
    *   **Background:** Very light gray/off-white (`#F5F5F5`) for the page body, pure white (`#FFF`) for the cards.
*   **Typography:** Persian/Arabic script (RTL direction). Sans-serif font (likely IRANSans or similar). Clear hierarchy with bold titles and smaller metadata.
*   **RTL Direction:** The entire interface is Right-to-Left, with navigation and text alignment suited for Persian language speakers.

**Note on Overlays:** The screenshot also shows a modal/popup (white box with a loading spinner) and a bottom-right floating action button (orange circle with a play/icon), indicating interactive elements for additional features like chat or tutorials.
